title: Otter with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water ripple beneath -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#3EC6E0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='26' ry='3' fill='#7FE3F2'/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 76 Q10 80 14 88 Q20 90 26 84 Z' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <path d='M22 77 Q14 81 17 86 Q22 87 26 83 Z' fill='#B07A50'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#A0683C'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#E8C79A'/>
  
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='72' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(-20 28 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='72' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(20 72 72)'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='23' ry='20' fill='#A0683C'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='32' r='6' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='32' r='3' fill='#C98B5E'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='6' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='3' fill='#C98B5E'/>
  
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#E8C79A'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='53' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F4A6A6'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='53' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F4A6A6'/>
  
  <!-- eyes - big sparkly -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='7' fill='#2B1B10'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='5.5' fill='#3D6B4F'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='4' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- sparkles on left eye -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='41' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='46.5' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='7' fill='#2B1B10'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='5.5' fill='#3D6B4F'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='4' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- sparkles on right eye -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62.5' cy='46.5' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2B1B10'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='49' rx='1.2' ry='0.8' fill='#6B4A33'/>
  
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 53 Q47 57 44 56' fill='none' stroke='#6B4A33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 53 Q53 57 56 56' fill='none' stroke='#6B4A33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='24' y1='50' x2='35' y2='53' stroke='#E8C79A' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='55' x2='35' y2='56' stroke='#E8C79A' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='50' x2='65' y2='53' stroke='#E8C79A' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='55' x2='65' y2='56' stroke='#E8C79A' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- extra sparkles around face -->
  <path d='M20 40 L22 43 L20 46 L18 43 Z' fill='#FFE66D' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M80 38 L81 41 L80 44 L79 41 Z' fill='#FFE66D' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='62' r='1.5' fill='#FFE66D' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
